name: Donald Wildmore
description:
Donald Wilmore is a licensed contractor and owner of Bay City Remodeling & Bathrooms LLC, a residential remodeling business based in Brandon, Florida. Florida corporate records previously located in this research identify him as the company’s manager and registered agent. Those roles establish his formal connection to the business, but do not establish that he is its founder or sole owner. The state record could not be retrieved again during this follow-up, so those titles should be reconfirmed before publication.

Work and business focus
Through Bay City Remodeling & Bathrooms, Wilmore is associated with a business offering bathroom and kitchen renovations, whole-home remodeling, home additions, drywall installation and repair, and outdoor living improvements. The company describes a service model that takes homeowners from initial planning and material selection through construction and finishing. Its advertised projects range from updating fixtures, tile, cabinetry, and countertops to larger changes involving room layouts, additional living space, patios, decks, pergolas, and outdoor kitchens. These are the company’s advertised capabilities, rather than a verified inventory of projects personally performed by Wilmore.

The company serves Brandon and surrounding Tampa Bay communities, including Riverview, Valrico, Seffner, Tampa, Plant City, Apollo Beach, Ruskin, and Temple Terrace. Its website positions the business around customized renovations, homeowner communication, and attention to craftsmanship.

Client relationships and project involvement
Customer testimonials published by Bay City Remodeling identify Donald by first name and suggest that he takes a direct, customer-facing role in projects. One customer, Lesley U., credits him with making a potentially stressful experience easier. Another, Darlene F., thanks Donald while praising ongoing communication and the completion of her projects in two days. These accounts support describing him as involved in customer relationships, although they do not establish his precise responsibilities on every job.

Other testimonials describe bathroom renovations, kitchen remodeling, and whole-home improvements. One customer reports having a shower modified for accessibility within three days and within budget. These are customer-reported experiences selected for publication on the company’s website, not independently audited assessments or guarantees of future performance.

Earlier business connections
There is evidence of a connection between the current business and the Springhill Construction name. A Nextdoor page whose URL refers to “Springhill Construction Remodeling LLC” now identifies the business as Bay City Remodeling & Bathrooms LLC and lists the current company’s website and business phone number. This establishes continuity at the directory-listing level, but does not by itself prove a legal name change, acquisition, or uninterrupted corporate history.

Experience and business positioning
Bay City Remodeling advertises more than 18 years of experience, negotiable pricing, veteran discounts, and insurance, bonding, and workers’ compensation coverage.
